speaking.scenario: Your manager asks what has been completed and what remains.
hints: I can give you an update before lunch.
Say what happened or what you need.
Add one clear reason or next step.
speaking.oneMinuteGoal: Introduce the situation, state your message, and give one reason or detail.
speaking.twoMinuteGoal: Introduce the situation, give two supporting details, explain the next step, and close politely.
speaking.modelResponse: So far, we've completed the first draft and checked the numbers. We still need to review the conclusion. I expect to send the final version tomorrow afternoon.
